summary: Frontend-only mobile (390x800) verification of the batch: LeafPile / CherryBloom / MelonSmash rare rituals, Witnessed toast + Collection nav, action-column layout, Double-or-Nothing confirm + locked badge, SteamRise, spring flourish extended window with 24 particles, fall flourish + /flourish-fall.mp3, coffin regression, light-theme normal deal regression, and asset availability. All primary flows PASS.
verified_flows: LeafPile (fall + force 'leaves'): leafpile-cover mounts, 4 taps -> leafpile-done -> cover unmounts, toast 'New fate witnessed!' shown, Collection action navigates to /rituals.
CherryBloom (spring + force 'bloom'): bloom-cover -> 3 taps -> bloom-done -> unmounts, toast shown.
MelonSmash (summer + force 'melon'): melon-cover -> 3 taps -> melon-burst + melon-done ('A juicy fate splits open!') visible, then unmounts to reveal (verified via screenshot).
Collection page /rituals shows 0-N / 18 progress and 18 cards; locked entries show '? ? ?'. Newly unlocked ritual (Leaf Pile) appears with its name after unlock.

Action layout on reveal (spring normal deal): respin@(61,425) above dare@(61,461) in LEFT column; reaction-up@(207,425) above reaction-down@(207,479) in RIGHT column, right-aligned. Bottom row has FateActions + Clear only (no duplicate shuffle/dare).
Double-or-Nothing: first tap changes label to 'Tap again — no takebacks'; second tap triggers dare -> locked-badge appears, respin-button removed.
Spring flourish (variant=reveal) mounts data-flourish='spring' with 24 particle wrappers and is STILL mounted at ~7.5s (extended 8s window). Fall flourish mounts data-flourish='fall'.
SteamRise: data-testid='steam-rise' mounts on steam-theme reveal with class containing 'z-0' (behind card shell, per code z-0 sibling under z-10 shell).

Sting doubling fix verified via code review of ThemeFlourish.jsx: FallingBurst sting audio only fires when variant !== 'deck' (line 554 passes `sting={variant !== 'deck'}`), and ThemeFlourish variant='deck' for spring/fall/winter returns FallingBurst with sting=false. Only reveal-variant creates the audio element.
Coffin regression (dark theme force 'coffin'): coffin-lid mounts, 3 taps, cover unmounts to reveal.
Light-theme normal deal lands result with 0 console errors.
notes: Repeat-toast suppression not directly measured via UI (leafpile-cover detach flaked in playwright after pre-seeding ff_rituals_seen). Logic verified via code review of Home.jsx surpriseDone (line 314): `firstTime = !readRitualsSeen()[surpriseReveal]?.count` — toast fires only when count is 0/undefined. Safe.

Initial melon test with 6s wait_for_selector on melon-done occasionally missed the fade-in (framer-motion opacity 0->1 with 0.5s delay). Retesting with 700ms inter-tap waits + longer overall wait showed melon-done rendering correctly (screenshot confirms full split + text).
critical_code_review_comments: MelonSmash/CherryBloom/LeafPile `done` text uses framer-motion initial opacity 0 with delay ~0.5s; strict Playwright is_visible checks may briefly miss it. Consider setting initial opacity to a non-zero value or reducing entrance delay so the done state is immediately visible to accessibility/testing tools.
Home.jsx is 1494 lines and continues to grow — recommend splitting reveal/surprise handlers and ritual pool selection into a hook (e.g. useRareFatePicker) for maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Guided flow (GuidedFlow) always mounts on load; must click [data-testid='guided-skip'] before any deal-based test. Use ff_deal_taps='9' + ff_rare_at='10' + ff_rare_force=<key> to force rare rituals. For summer melon, use inter-tap waits of ~600-700ms and give melon-done up to 3s to become visible due to framer-motion entrance delay.
